name: s81pq_qb_bankp_native-b1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 PQ QB pipelined SRAM bank (x4), canonical +2 QB pipeline

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_pq_qb_bankp_native u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_PQ_ROM_PORTS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/pq/ot_s81_pq_qb_pipe_native.sv physical/s81_pq_hier/pinned/rtl/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81pq_qb_bankp_native/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81pq_qb_bankp_native/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81pq_qb_bankp_native --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_pq_qb_bankp_native --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW master (S-ELEM-PQ/LEGACY 2026-10-16, ROOT GAP 1): ot_s81_pq_qb_bankp_native is the QB SRAM bank of the canonical PQ hierarchy (OT_PQ_QB_PIPE + OT_PQ_QB_PHYS_SPLIT, tools/s81/pq_native_hierarchy.py), x4 in both ot_s81_pq_qb_pipe_native and ot_s81_pq_qb_pinread_native (P10 headpc); it had no kit. Same 142.56x86.4 footprint and S aq_q / N rd / W control faces as the legacy bank0..3 slot (no new footprint); one 128x256 1R1W SRAM; every pin registered in RTL (capture + output register = the canonical +2).
